verse.verse_2: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
verse.verse_3: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.
verse.verse_4: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
verse.verse_6: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
verse.verse_7: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -
verse.verse_8: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
verse.verse_10: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_11: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
verse.verse_12: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
verse.verse_13: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
verse.verse_14: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.
verse.verse_15: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
verse.verse_16: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
verse.verse_17: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
verse.verse_18: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -
verse.verse_19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -
verse.verse_21: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).
verse.verse_22: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
verse.verse_24: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
verse.verse_25: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,
verse.verse_26: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -
verse.verse_27: And mixed with water of Tasnim,
verse.verse_28: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.
verse.verse_29: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
verse.verse_30: And wink one to another when they passed them;
verse.verse_31: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;
verse.verse_32: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
verse.verse_33: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
verse.verse_34: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
verse.verse_36: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?
